reviews.title: Buggy and Unreliable
reviews.text:
Auto-failing games: The app often times out questions immediately or answers them incorrectly without user input. 

Connection errors: "network unavailable" errors or the app freezes at the startup screen. 

Lag and Glitches: lag spikes, green blank screens, and the app crashing or kicking during live games. 

Update Problems: Recent app updates have been blamed for breaking functionality, such as failing to track bonus rejoins or not loading answer options. 

Low Earnings and Value: The financial reward for playing is insufficient compared to the time and effort required.

Minimal Payouts: Winners of live games often receive only 30 to 50 Swagbucks (approx. $0.30–$0.50), with rare maximums around 115 Swagbucks.

Time-Consuming: The live trivia games involve long periods of host commentary and waiting. 15-minute sessions often result in minimal gain, 5-7SB, if you don’t win. 

Daily Goal Impact: Changes to the platform have removed bonus Swagbucks from other activities (like Swagit), making the unreliable trivia challenge a potential net negative for completing daily goals.

reviews.title: Legit & Live
reviews.text:
Swagbucks Live Trivia is actually really fun. I started playing just to try it out and now I look forward to the games. The questions aren’t crazy hard, but they definitely make you think. It’s cool that you can win real money just for answering trivia on your phone.

Even if you don’t win the big prize, you can still earn SB in other ways in the app, so it doesn’t feel like a waste of time. It’s an easy, low-stress way to make a little extra cash while just relaxing at home. Definitely worth downloading if you like trivia!

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: There are many issues during live games, such as sound cutting out, hosts not reading the questions in time with the timer, hosts not reading the chat especially when things go wrong, the chat being unmoderated and people commenting things that have nothing to do with the games, people commenting incorrect answers, and also getting kicked during the game. I also dislike that we can’t change our answers after clicking on one and only being able to use one rejoin per game. They should make it so you can change your answer if it’s before the timer runs out and also make it so you can use more rejoins based on how many games you’ve played/won. Also, during hostless trivia, the game sometimes freezes after clicking an answer or marks it wrong when it’s right, and some questions have spelling errors. Some questions are also extremely repetitive.
